body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs` contains 33 `try/finally` blocks and a local `cleanup(root)` helper dedicated solely to removing temporary fixture directories. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit`, this test file can adopt `tmp(t)` with automatic `t.after` cleanup.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update `fixture(t, options)` helper to take `t` as its first argument and allocate the root directory using `tmp(t, 'adlc-cursor-')`.
   - Update all test cases calling `fixture` to pass `t`.
   - Remove all 33 `try { ... } finally { cleanup(root); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete the local `const cleanup = (root) => ...` helper.
2. Verify all tests pass: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs` reports 0 (down from 33).
- AC2 Local `cleanup` helper is removed.
- AC3 `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC4 `npm test -w plugins/adlc-cursor` exits 0.
- AC5 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(adlc-cursor): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 33 try/finally blocks in rails-guard tests
